moneyOverview.title: Money overview
moneyOverview.sub: Where the shop's money stands now: what came in, what the couriers still owe, what is owed to customers. From the shop's own records; nothing is changed here.

received.title: Cash received
received.sub: Payments that came in (also those refunded since — the money did arrive)
received.none: No payment came in during the last 30 days.

cod.title: COD due from couriers
cod.sub: Cash riders collected that no courier payout has settled yet
cod.none: No courier owes the shop anything now.

refunds.title: Refunds waiting
refunds.sub: Money owed to customers: asked for or approved, not yet paid out
refunds.where: Approve and record each refund on Refunds & wallet.

claims.title: Courier claims to receive
claims.sub: Money the couriers still owe the shop on claims it has raised (open or sent)
claims.none: No courier owes the shop a claim now.

moneyOverview.vatOff: VAT is off, so Finance has no VAT tab.
moneyOverview.vatLink: Turn VAT on or set rates
